title: Indicator of predicate acceptance
statement:
For any triple of signs $y=(y_0,y_1,y_2)$, the indicator of whether the predicate accepts $y$ is
\[
\mathbf{1}_{\{\text{the predicate accepts }y\}}=\frac34-\frac{s(y_0)}4-\frac{s(y_1)s(y_2)}4-\frac{s(y_0)s(y_1)s(y_2)}4,
\]
where $s$ denotes the real value of a sign.
